## Summary

Describe the problem and the change.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor or maintenance
- [ ] Security, privacy, accessibility, or reliability improvement

## Validation

List the exact commands or manual checks you ran and their results.

- [ ] Tests
- [ ] Type checking
- [ ] Production build
- [ ] Manual verification (describe below)

## Safety, privacy, and data impact

Describe any effect on user data, external services, permissions, safety-related text, or data provenance. Write "Not applicable" when there is no impact.

## Checklist

- [ ] I reviewed the change and understand the behaviour it introduces.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation.
- [ ] I did not commit secrets or real personal data.
- [ ] I used synthetic data in tests and screenshots.
- [ ] I have described checks that were not run.
- [ ] I disclosed AI assistance where relevant and required.
